summary.ru: Ангола, также Ангола, официальное название — Республика Ангола — государство в Южной Африке. Бывшая португальская колония, получившая независимость в 1975 году. Член ООН с 1 декабря 1976 года.
summary.en: Angola, officially the Republic of Angola, is a country on the western coast of Southern Africa. It is the second-largest Portuguese-speaking country after Brazil in both total area and population and is the seventh-largest country in Africa. It is bordered by Namibia to the south, the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the north, Zambia to the east, and the Atlantic Ocean to the west. The Angolan province of Cabinda is an exclave on the Atlantic coast, bordering the Republic of the Congo and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The capital and most populous city is Luanda.
